title: GA4 key events versus enquiries: a practical measurement audit
seoTitle: GA4 key events and enquiry tracking | Faraz Ansari
description: Learn to audit GA4 key events, separate page views and contact clicks from confirmed enquiries, and test consent-aware website measurement.
deck: A practical measurement audit that distinguishes browsing, contact intent and confirmed outcomes before treating a number as a conversion.
heroAlt: Conceptual editorial graphic showing a page view, a contact-intent action and a confirmed enquiry as separate measurement stages
heroCaption: A measured interaction is not always a confirmed outcome. Separate the stages before reporting.
